verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community comment implying Elastic offers alerting as a paid feature, which suggests some rule-triggered automation exists. Automatic embedding generation on indexing into `semantic_text` is a built-in behavior, not a user-defined rule. No first-party documentation in the pack describes defining event rules or the actions they trigger. Missing for 10: first-party docs on rule/alert definition, evidence of configurable actions (webhooks, connectors, agent invocations), event trigger types, licensing/tier clarity, and hands-on corroboration.
